page: Microsoft Azure E8ds_v7 is an Edsv7-family virtual machine configured with 8 vCPUs and 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB per core memory-to-vCPU ratio. It runs on the x86_64 architecture using an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 4 physical cores and 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The CPU features a 480 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX).

This server includes 472 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, utilizing the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. In benchmark testing, the E8ds_v7 exhibits strong single-threaded performance, scoring in the top 25% for gzip compression at 35.21 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 14.51 GB/sec. Other core metrics, such as stress-ng CPU performance and large-block memory bandwidth (85.42 GB/sec read, 37.89 GB/sec write), fall within the average range.

Given its high memory density of 8 GB per vCPU and dedicated CPU allocation, the E8ds_v7 provides a balanced resource profile for memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of GPU hardware. It is suited for relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, and data processing tasks. The inclusion of local NVMe storage and advanced cryptography instruction sets like AES and SHA_NI enhances its utility for secure, data-heavy operations.
